canonical_name: Dark City Blues Jam (presented by the Black Mountain Blues Society)
summary: A twice-monthly (1st and 3rd Tuesdays) blues jam at White Horse Black Mountain, presented by the Black Mountain Blues Society, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit with a formal membership program and member band directory. The jam alternates between two named hosts (Peggy Ratusz and Bill Mattocks) backed by a house rhythm section, with musicians signing up to sit in and a stripped-back acoustic circle preceding the electric stage jam.

evidence.note: Listing describes it as the community coming together to 'keep the tradition alive,' starting with a front-porch style acoustic circle before the plugged-in stage jam.
Explore Asheville describes it as presented by the Black Mountain Blues Society and White Horse Black Mountain, a recurring community celebration of blues.
Facebook post confirms the jam alternates between two named regular hosts, Peggy Ratusz and Bill Mattocks, on 1st and 3rd Tuesdays, backed by a house rhythm section.

The presenting organization, Black Mountain Blues Society, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit with a formal membership program and a member band directory, indicating a real recurring community of musicians rather than a purely commercial booking.

Both units are the same recurring jam under slightly different scraped titles/sources (MOUNTAIN_X and LIVE_MUSIC_AVL), same venue and near-identical descriptions, so they represent one group, not two.
